$comment: The Incident RCA history tables (ADR 0031), version 2 of this file: what NB_DatabaseHub_LiveActivity writes to LH_DatabaseHub, what SM_DatabaseHub_History reads, and what the Insights app queries. Each table names the document that carries it (document): the evidence document (ContosoCare.RcaEvidence, version 1, unchanged: its eight tables, evidence.schema.json) or the sidecar (ContosoCare.RcaSidecar, version 1: Query Store's statistics, waits, plans, events, and coverage on T1 to T4, and who holds T4's connections, sidecar.schema.json). A consumer checks a document's kind and version, never this file's. The notebook, the semantic model, and the app test against this file; rca/README.md explains it. Types are the notebook's TABLE_COLUMNS types; model types are TMDL data types.

string.document: index into the document's strings, or null

timestamp.document: integer milliseconds after the document's epochUtc, or null

date.document: not in the document: the notebook derives it

notebookColumns.name: run_id
notebookColumns.description: The notebook's RUN_ID: session-<SESSION_ID> for a control session, as the other history tables. A sidecar's rows take their own session's, session-<sessionId>, whichever run wrote them (rca/README.md, The sidecar).

notebookColumns.name: document_id
notebookColumns.description: The document the row came from (documentId): an evidence document's, or a sidecar's.

notebookColumns.name: report_date_utc
notebookColumns.description: The UTC date of the row's primary time; relates the table to Date, as the other history tables.

tables.name: rca_sessions
tables.grain: One session in one sample of a blocking chain: every session that waits on another, and every session another waits on.

columns.name: captured_at_utc
columns.description: When the observer took the sample (UTC).

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, T3, T4, or T4-replica.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: The SQL Server session_id (SPID) or the PostgreSQL pid.

columns.name: blocked_by
columns.description: Comma-separated IDs of the sessions this one waits on (SQL Server: blocking_session_id, including the documented negative owners; PostgreSQL: pg_blocking_pids, or the lock's holders from pg_locks). Null when it isn't blocked.

columns.name: status
columns.description: SQL Server: the request's status when the session has a request (running, runnable, suspended), else the session's (sleeping). PostgreSQL: pg_stat_activity.state (active, idle, idle in transaction).

columns.name: wait_type
columns.description: SQL Server wait_type, or PostgreSQL wait_event_type:wait_event.

columns.name: wait_ms
columns.description: How long the current wait has lasted.

columns.name: wait_resource
columns.description: SQL Server wait_resource; PostgreSQL's lock tag (locktype and its fields).

columns.name: lock_resource_type
columns.description: KEY, PAGE, RID, OBJECT, XACT (SQL Server); relation, tuple, transactionid (PostgreSQL).

columns.name: lock_object
columns.description: The locked table, [schema].[table] on SQL Server or schema.table on PostgreSQL, when the lock names one.

columns.name: lock_index
columns.description: The locked index, for KEY and PAGE locks.

columns.name: lock_mode_wanted
columns.description: The mode this session waits for.

columns.name: lock_mode_held
columns.description: The mode this session holds on the resource others wait for.

columns.name: open_transactions
columns.description: Open transactions (SQL Server open_transaction_count; PostgreSQL 1 when xact_start is set).

columns.name: transaction_age_ms
columns.description: How long its oldest open transaction has been open.

columns.name: idle_ms
columns.description: How long an idle session (sleeping, or idle in transaction) has been idle.

columns.name: login_name
columns.description: The login or role. The workload's own sessions only; null for any other session.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: The client host. The workload's own sessions only.

columns.name: program_name
columns.description: The application name as a DBA would see it, without the workload's internal segments (rca/README.md, Names). The workload's own sessions only.

columns.name: run_token
columns.description: An opaque token shared by the sessions of one workload run, so the rules can group them; it names nothing (rca/README.md, Names).

columns.name: module_name
columns.description: The stored procedure or function the statement belongs to: [schema].[name] on SQL Server, the called function on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: statement_text
columns.description: The running statement, or the last one for an idle session, normalized (literals replaced, at most 2,000 characters).

columns.name: input_buffer
columns.description: SQL Server's input buffer for an idle session (the last batch or RPC), normalized.

columns.name: backend_type
columns.description: PostgreSQL backend_type (client backend, startup, walreceiver, walsender).

columns.name: is_demo
columns.description: True for the demo workload's own sessions, the baseline's and any fault's alike, which keep text, login, and host; false for any other session, which arrives without them.

tables.name: rca_waits
tables.grain: One wait type's delta over one phase of a capture episode: the episode itself, or the baseline just before it.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, or T3.

columns.name: episode_id
columns.description: The observer's capture episode (rca_events kind capture, event_name escalated, code) the row belongs to.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: baseline (the minutes before the episode) or episode.

columns.name: window_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the delta's window.

columns.name: window_end_utc
columns.description: End of the delta's window.

columns.name: wait_type
columns.description: The wait type.

columns.name: wait_category
columns.description: Its category from Learn's wait categories mapping table.

columns.name: wait_ms
columns.description: Wait time in the window.

columns.name: waiting_tasks
columns.description: Waits that ended in the window.

columns.name: signal_ms
columns.description: Signal wait time in the window.

columns.name: max_wait_ms
columns.description: The longest single wait seen (the cumulative maximum when it rose in the window).

tables.name: rca_events
tables.grain: One server-side event, or one count of identical events per minute: an error, an attention, a deadlock, a lock escalation, a tuning change, or the observer's own capture escalation.

columns.name: event_time_utc
columns.description: When it happened; for a count, the start of its minute.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1 to T5, or T4-replica.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: error, attention, deadlock, escalation, tuning, or capture.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: The source event: the Extended Events event (error_reported, attention, xml_deadlock_report, database_xml_deadlock_report, lock_escalation), the counter (pg_stat_database.deadlocks), the tuning change, or for capture: escalated or relaxed.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: The session the event belongs to; for a deadlock, its victim.

columns.name: program_name
columns.description: As in RCA Sessions: the workload's own sessions only, without internal segments.

columns.name: run_token
columns.description: As in RCA Sessions.

columns.name: login_name
columns.description: The workload's own sessions only.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: The workload's own sessions only.

columns.name: module_name
columns.description: The module the event's statement belongs to.

columns.name: code
columns.description: The SQL Server error number or the PostgreSQL SQLSTATE; for capture, the episode's ID.

columns.name: severity
columns.description: The SQL Server error severity.

columns.name: intercepted
columns.description: True when the statement's own TRY...CATCH handled the error (error_reported's is_intercepted).

columns.name: event_count
columns.description: 1 for one event; the count when identical events are counted per minute.

columns.name: object_name
columns.description: The object the event names: the escalated table, a deadlock's first resource, the tuned query.

columns.name: lock_mode
columns.description: The lock mode of an escalation.

columns.name: detail
columns.description: The event in plain words, normalized: the error message, the escalation's lock counts, the tuning state, or the signal and value that started or ended a capture episode.

columns.name: deadlock_json
columns.description: For a deadlock: its graph reduced to JSON (rca/README.md, Deadlocks).

tables.name: rca_queries
tables.note: Never written: Query Store's evidence travels in the sidecar's tables (rca_query_stats, rca_query_waits, rca_query_plans), so the evidence document stays as it is. The notebook and the model keep the table as they have it.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, or T3.

columns.name: episode_id
columns.description: The observer's capture episode.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: baseline or episode.

columns.name: interval_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the Query Store intervals summed.

columns.name: interval_end_utc
columns.description: End of the Query Store intervals summed.

columns.name: query_id
columns.description: Query Store query_id.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Query Store plan_id.

columns.name: query_hash
columns.description: The query hash, as hex.

columns.name: module_name
columns.description: The module the query belongs to.

columns.name: statement_text
columns.description: The query text, normalized.

columns.name: executions
columns.description: Executions in the phase.

columns.name: cpu_ms
columns.description: Total CPU time.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.description: Total duration.

columns.name: logical_reads
columns.description: Total logical reads.

columns.name: physical_reads
columns.description: Total physical reads.

columns.name: log_bytes
columns.description: Total log bytes used.

columns.name: max_used_memory_kb
columns.description: The largest memory grant used.

columns.name: max_dop
columns.description: The highest degree of parallelism.

columns.name: plans_for_query

columns.name: is_forced_plan

columns.name: plan_forcing_type

tables.name: rca_query_stats
tables.grain: One Query Store plan's runtime statistics over one Query Store interval on one target, as one read saw it (on PostgreSQL, one role's query: its rows are per query). A later read of the same interval holds the same plan's counts or more, so readers keep the latest read of each target, interval, login, query, and plan (rca/README.md, Query Store).

columns.name: captured_at_utc
columns.description: When the observer read the interval (UTC). Of two reads of one interval, the later one holds the whole of it.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, T3, or T4.

columns.name: interval_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the Query Store interval: SQL Server's sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval.start_time, PostgreSQL's query_store.qs_view.start_time.

columns.name: interval_end_utc
columns.description: End of the interval. An interval SQL Server still had open when it was read, at the capture's end, ends after captured_at_utc.

columns.name: query_id
columns.description: Query Store's query_id: SQL Server's within the database; PostgreSQL's 64-bit hash of the statement's parse tree.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Query Store's plan_id: SQL Server's within the database; on PostgreSQL, qs_view's own, 0 when it reports none (T4 stores no plans: pg_qs.store_query_plans stays off).

columns.name: login_name
columns.description: PostgreSQL's role that ran the query (qs_view's user_id), for the workload's own role only; another role's rows are summed with a null login (rca/README.md, Names). Null on SQL Server, whose Query Store records no user.

columns.name: query_hash
columns.description: SQL Server's query_hash, as 0x and 16 hexadecimal digits; null on PostgreSQL, whose query_id is the hash.

columns.name: plan_hash
columns.description: SQL Server's query_plan_hash, as 0x and 16 hexadecimal digits; null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: module_name
columns.description: The stored procedure, function, or trigger the statement belongs to, [schema].[name]; null for an ad hoc statement, and on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: statement_text
columns.description: The statement as Query Store keeps it, normalized as RCA Sessions' are (literals replaced, comments removed, at most 2,000 characters).

columns.name: executions
columns.description: Executions in the interval, aborted and failed ones included: SQL Server's count_executions, PostgreSQL's calls.

columns.name: aborted_executions
columns.description: Executions the client cancelled or that ended in an error (SQL Server's execution types Aborted and Exception); null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: cpu_ms
columns.description: Total CPU time in milliseconds (SQL Server's avg_cpu_time times executions); null on PostgreSQL, whose Query Store records no CPU time.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.description: Total elapsed time in milliseconds: SQL Server's avg_duration times executions, PostgreSQL's total_time.

columns.name: max_duration_ms
columns.description: The longest single execution in milliseconds: SQL Server's max_duration, PostgreSQL's max_time.

columns.name: logical_reads
columns.description: Pages read: SQL Server's 8-KB pages (avg_logical_io_reads times executions); PostgreSQL's shared blocks hit and read.

columns.name: physical_reads
columns.description: Pages read from storage: SQL Server's avg_physical_io_reads times executions; PostgreSQL's shared blocks read.

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Rows returned or changed: SQL Server's avg_rowcount times executions, PostgreSQL's rows.

columns.name: log_bytes
columns.description: Transaction log the statement wrote, in bytes (SQL Server's avg_log_bytes_used times executions); null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: tempdb_kb
columns.description: tempdb space used, in KB (SQL Server's avg_tempdb_space_used times executions, in 8-KB pages); on PostgreSQL its temporary blocks written, 8 KB each.

columns.name: max_used_memory_kb
columns.description: The largest memory grant one execution used, in KB (SQL Server's max_query_max_used_memory, in 8-KB pages); null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: max_dop
columns.description: The highest degree of parallelism (SQL Server's max_dop); null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: wait_ms
columns.description: Time it waited, every wait category: SQL Server's sys.query_store_wait_stats; PostgreSQL's sampled waits, an estimate (RCA Query Waits). Null when nothing was recorded.

columns.name: first_execution_utc
columns.description: When the plan's first execution in the interval ended (SQL Server's first_execution_time, which is an execution's end time): not the instant a plan changed. Null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: last_execution_utc
columns.description: When the plan's last execution in the interval ended (SQL Server's last_execution_time); null on PostgreSQL.

tables.name: rca_query_waits
tables.grain: One wait category (SQL Server) or wait event (PostgreSQL) of one Query Store plan (on PostgreSQL, one role's query) over one interval, as one read saw it: each plan's or query's three largest in the interval. Readers keep the latest read, as for RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: captured_at_utc
columns.description: When the observer read the interval (UTC).

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, T3, or T4.

columns.name: interval_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the Query Store interval.

columns.name: interval_end_utc
columns.description: End of the interval.

columns.name: query_id
columns.description: Query Store's query_id, as in RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Query Store's plan_id on SQL Server; 0 on PostgreSQL, whose wait sampling records waits per query, not per plan.

columns.name: login_name
columns.description: As in RCA Query Stats: PostgreSQL's role, the workload's own only; null on SQL Server.

columns.name: wait_category
columns.description: SQL Server's wait_category_desc (Lock, CPU, Buffer IO, Memory, Parallelism, Tran Log IO, Network IO, ...); PostgreSQL's wait_event_type (Lock, LWLock, IO, Client, IPC, ...).

columns.name: wait_event
columns.description: PostgreSQL's wait_event (transactionid, relation, DataFileRead, ...); null on SQL Server, whose Query Store keeps categories only.

columns.name: wait_ms
columns.description: Time waited, in milliseconds: SQL Server's total_query_wait_time_ms; on PostgreSQL the samples times pgms_wait_sampling.history_period (100 ms by default), an estimate.

columns.name: max_wait_ms
columns.description: The longest single wait, in milliseconds (SQL Server's max_query_wait_time_ms); null on PostgreSQL.

columns.name: samples
columns.description: How many times PostgreSQL's wait sampling found the query waiting on it (calls); null on SQL Server.

tables.name: rca_query_plans
tables.grain: One Query Store plan as one read saw it: when it was compiled and last ran, whether it was forced and how, its forcing failures, and its shape. A read lists the plans of the queries in its RCA Query Stats rows and every forced plan.

columns.name: captured_at_utc
columns.description: When the observer read the plan (UTC).

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, or T3.

columns.name: query_id
columns.description: Query Store's query_id.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Query Store's plan_id.

columns.name: query_hash
columns.description: The query's query_hash, as in RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: plan_hash
columns.description: The plan's query_plan_hash, as in RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: module_name
columns.description: The module the query belongs to, as in RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: statement_text
columns.description: The query's statement, normalized, as in RCA Query Stats.

columns.name: compiled_utc
columns.description: When the plan was first compiled (initial_compile_start_time).

columns.name: last_compiled_utc
columns.description: When it was last compiled (last_compile_start_time).

columns.name: last_execution_utc
columns.description: When it last ran (last_execution_time).

columns.name: compiles
columns.description: How many times it was compiled (count_compiles).

columns.name: is_forced_plan
columns.description: True when the plan is forced, by sys.sp_query_store_force_plan or by automatic plan correction.

columns.name: forcing_type
columns.description: MANUAL, AUTO, or NONE (plan_forcing_type_desc).

columns.name: force_failures
columns.description: How many times forcing it failed (force_failure_count).

columns.name: last_force_failure
columns.description: Why forcing it last failed (last_force_failure_reason_desc); null when it never failed.

columns.name: plans_for_query
columns.description: How many plans the query has in Query Store.

columns.name: estimated_cost
columns.description: The plan's estimated cost (its showplan's StatementSubTreeCost).

columns.name: is_parallel
columns.description: True when the plan is parallel (is_parallel_plan).

columns.name: plan_summary
columns.description: The plan's shape in words, from its showplan: its costliest operators with their objects and indexes, its warnings, and a missing index it suggests; never a parameter's value (rca/README.md, Query Store). At most 1,000 characters.

tables.name: rca_query_events
tables.grain: One change in Query Store or in automatic tuning that the capture saw on one target: a plan forced or unforced, Query Store's state changing, automatic tuning's option, or a tuning recommendation's state.

columns.name: event_time_utc
columns.description: When the capture first saw the change (UTC): within one read's period after it happened (RCA-SQL-15 every 60 s, RCA-AZ-03 and 04 every 30 s, RCA-PG-13 with each Query Store read); time_from_utc says since when it could have happened.

columns.name: time_from_utc
columns.description: The read before the one that saw the change: the change happened after it (UTC).

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, T3, or T4.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: forced, unforced, state (Query Store's actual state or capture mode changed), or tuning (automatic tuning's option, or a recommendation's state).

columns.name: query_id
columns.description: The query whose plan was forced or unforced, or whose recommendation changed; null for a state change.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: The plan forced or unforced; null for a state change.

columns.name: forcing_type
columns.description: MANUAL or AUTO for a forcing (plan_forcing_type_desc): forced by a person (sys.sp_query_store_force_plan) or by automatic plan correction.

columns.name: state
columns.description: The state after the change: Query Store's actual state (READ_WRITE, READ_ONLY, OFF, ERROR) or capture mode on PostgreSQL (top, all, none), automatic tuning's actual state, or the recommendation's state.

columns.name: previous_state
columns.description: The state the read before saw; null when a recommendation first appears.

columns.name: detail
columns.description: The change in plain words, normalized: for READ_ONLY, its readonly_reason in words (for example, the storage limit); for a recommendation, its reason.

tables.name: rca_query_coverage
tables.grain: What the capture read of Query Store for one target over one sidecar's window, and what it couldn't, with why: Query Store's state and settings, the intervals it read, and on PostgreSQL the intervals still pending publication.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1, T2, T3, T4, or T4-replica, whose row says the replica records nothing in Query Store.

columns.name: window_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the sidecar's window for the target.

columns.name: window_end_utc
columns.description: End of the window.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Query Store's actual state as last read: READ_WRITE, READ_ONLY, OFF, or ERROR on SQL Server; the capture mode on PostgreSQL (top, all, or none); null when it couldn't be read (gaps says why).

columns.name: capture_mode
columns.description: Query Store's capture mode (SQL Server's query_capture_mode_desc; PostgreSQL's pg_qs.query_capture_mode) and, on PostgreSQL, wait sampling's (pgms_wait_sampling.query_capture_mode), as last read.

columns.name: interval_minutes
columns.description: Query Store's interval length in minutes, as last read.

columns.name: read_from_utc
columns.description: The start of the first interval the window's reads returned.

columns.name: read_to_utc
columns.description: The end of the last interval the window's reads returned.

columns.name: pending_from_utc
columns.description: PostgreSQL only: the start of the time Query Store hadn't published yet when the window ended (an interval shows once it ends); null when nothing is pending.

columns.name: pending_to_utc
columns.description: PostgreSQL only: the end of that time.

columns.name: backfill
columns.description: True when the sidecar holds intervals read after the session, which Query Store published later (rca/README.md, Pending publication).

columns.name: sources
columns.description: Comma-separated capture IDs that returned rows for the target in the window.

columns.name: gaps
columns.description: One gap per line: what wasn't read and why (Query Store off or read-only, a permission, a timeout, pending publication that expired or was lost when T4 stopped, the sidecar's budget).

tables.name: rca_resource
tables.grain: One counter or resource sample, in long format: the sentinel's counters, and the resource samples of capture episodes.

columns.name: at_utc
columns.description: When the sample was taken; for a delta, the end of its interval.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1 to T5, or T4-replica.

columns.name: source
columns.description: The capture ID that read it (rca/capture/README.md).

columns.name: metric
columns.description: The metric's name (rca/README.md, Resource metrics).

columns.name: value
columns.description: The value: a gauge's reading, or a counter's delta over the interval.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: count, percent, ms, bytes, or per second.

tables.name: rca_replica
tables.grain: One replay sample from one side of T4's replication: the read replica's replay state and conflicts, or the primary's view of the standby.

columns.name: at_utc
columns.description: When the sample was taken.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T4-replica for the replica's side, T4 for the primary's.

columns.name: side
columns.description: replica or primary.

columns.name: standby_name
columns.description: The primary's name for the standby (pg_stat_replication.application_name).

columns.name: since_last_replayed_s
columns.description: now() minus pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() on the replica.

columns.name: received_not_replayed_bytes
columns.description: pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() minus pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() on the replica.

columns.name: replay_lag_s
columns.description: pg_stat_replication.replay_lag on the primary.

columns.name: write_lag_s
columns.description: pg_stat_replication.write_lag on the primary.

columns.name: flush_lag_s
columns.description: pg_stat_replication.flush_lag on the primary.

columns.name: send_gap_bytes
columns.description: The primary's current WAL position minus what it sent.

columns.name: wal_bytes_per_s
columns.description: WAL the primary generated per second since the previous sample (pg_stat_wal); null on the first sample, which has none before it.

columns.name: startup_wait
columns.description: The replica's startup (replay) process wait, wait_event_type:wait_event: only on a replay-detail sample that found it waiting on a lock, with the conflict's columns; null otherwise.

columns.name: conflict_relation
columns.description: The table whose lock replay waits for, from pg_locks.

columns.name: conflict_wanted_mode
columns.description: The lock mode replay waits for (AccessExclusiveLock).

columns.name: conflict_wait_start_utc
columns.description: When replay started to wait (pg_locks.waitstart).

columns.name: conflict_holder_session
columns.description: The replica query's pid that holds the conflicting lock.

columns.name: conflict_holder_mode
columns.description: The holder's lock mode.

columns.name: conflict_holder_program
columns.description: The holder's application name, as program_name in RCA Sessions.

columns.name: conflict_holder_run_token
columns.description: As run_token in RCA Sessions.

columns.name: conflict_holder_statement
columns.description: The holder's statement, normalized.

columns.name: conflicts_cancelled
columns.description: Queries the replica cancelled for conflicts since the previous sample (pg_stat_database_conflicts); null on the first sample.

columns.name: max_standby_streaming_delay_s
columns.description: The replica's max_standby_streaming_delay, read once when a replay episode starts (RCA-PG-09) and kept on later samples; null before the first episode.

tables.name: rca_connections
tables.grain: One group of T4's client connections in one sample of a connection episode: those of one program, login, and state, counted, idle ones included; never the observer's own connection.

columns.name: captured_at_utc
columns.description: When the observer took the sample (UTC).

columns.name: program_name
columns.description: As in RCA Sessions: the application name without the workload's internal segments, for the workload's own connections; null for any other application's, whose name stays out (rca/README.md, Names).

columns.name: run_token
columns.description: As in RCA Sessions.

columns.name: login_name
columns.description: The role. The workload's own connections only.

columns.name: state
columns.description: pg_stat_activity.state: active, idle, idle in transaction, or idle in transaction (aborted); unknown when the server reports none.

columns.name: connections
columns.description: How many client connections the group held in the sample.

columns.name: waiting_lock
columns.description: How many of them waited on a lock (wait_event_type Lock).

columns.name: oldest_state_s
columns.description: How long the group's longest-standing connection had been in its state, in seconds (state_change).

columns.name: oldest_connection_s
columns.description: How long the group's oldest connection had been open, in seconds (backend_start).

columns.name: is_demo
columns.description: As in RCA Sessions: true for the demo workload's own connections, which keep their program and login.

tables.name: rca_coverage
tables.grain: What the observer captured for one target over one document's window, and what it didn't, with why.

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1 to T5, or T4-replica.

columns.name: window_start_utc
columns.description: Start of the window.

columns.name: window_end_utc
columns.description: End of the window.

columns.name: captured
columns.description: True when the sentinel ran for the whole window.

columns.name: sources
columns.description: Comma-separated capture IDs that returned rows for the target in the window, sentinel and detail alike. RCA-PG-08 (the WAL receiver) adds only coverage gaps.

columns.name: gaps
columns.description: One gap per line: what wasn't captured and why (a permission, a timeout, the export's budget).

tables.name: rca_answer_key
tables.grain: One fault the workload injected (kind run) or one event it reported about its own fault (kind run-event): the answer key, which only the scoreboard and the tests read.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: run (one injected fault, start to end) or run-event (an event the workload reported about it).

columns.name: target
columns.description: T1 to T5, or T4-replica.

columns.name: event_time_utc
columns.description: The run's start, or the event's time.

columns.name: end_time_utc
columns.description: The run's end.

columns.name: scenario
columns.description: The scenario ID (scenarios/<id>).

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.description: The runner's run ID.

columns.name: run_token
columns.description: The run's opaque token, which the detection tables carry, so grading can check that a blind finding names the injected run's sessions.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: For run-event: the event's name (demo.scenario_run_events).

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: For run: Completed, Stopped, TimedOut, or Failed.

columns.name: detail
columns.description: The run's parameters, or the event's detail.

relationshipNotes: Every table relates to Target and Date, as the other history tables. None relates to Incident Windows or Scenario Runs: the detection tables never meet the answer key in the model, and a second path from Target would make the model ambiguous.

measures.name: Blocked Sessions (captured)
measures.description: The most sessions blocked in one sample in context.
measures.definition: MAXX ( VALUES ( 'RCA Sessions'[Captured At UTC] ), CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'RCA Sessions' ), NOT ISBLANK ( 'RCA Sessions'[Blocked By] ) ) )

measures.name: Head Blocker Idle (s)
measures.description: The longest a head blocker (a session others wait on that waits on no one) sat idle, in seconds.
measures.definition: The maximum Idle (ms) / 1000 over sessions whose Session ID appears in another row's Blocked By in the same sample and whose own Blocked By is blank.

measures.name: Errors (captured)
measures.description: Errors the observer captured, intercepted ones included.

measures.name: Replica Replay Stall (s)
measures.description: The longest the read replica went without replaying a transaction, in seconds.
measures.definition: CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Replica'[Since Last Replayed (s)] ), 'RCA Replica'[Side] = "replica" )

measures.name: Query CPU (ms)
measures.description: Query Store's CPU time in context, in milliseconds: the latest read of each target, interval, login, query, and plan, summed, so several reads of one interval, or two sessions' reads of it, count it once.
measures.definition: SUMX ( SUMMARIZE ( 'RCA Query Stats', 'RCA Query Stats'[Target Key], 'RCA Query Stats'[Interval Start UTC], 'RCA Query Stats'[Login], 'RCA Query Stats'[Query ID], 'RCA Query Stats'[Plan ID] ), VAR latest = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'RCA Query Stats'[CPU (ms)] ), 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] = latest ) )

measures.name: Query Duration (ms)
measures.description: Query Store's elapsed time in context, in milliseconds: the latest read of each target, interval, login, query, and plan, summed.
measures.definition: SUMX ( SUMMARIZE ( 'RCA Query Stats', 'RCA Query Stats'[Target Key], 'RCA Query Stats'[Interval Start UTC], 'RCA Query Stats'[Login], 'RCA Query Stats'[Query ID], 'RCA Query Stats'[Plan ID] ), VAR latest = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Duration (ms)] ), 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] = latest ) )

measures.name: Query Executions
measures.description: Query Store's executions in context: the latest read of each target, interval, login, query, and plan, summed.
measures.definition: SUMX ( SUMMARIZE ( 'RCA Query Stats', 'RCA Query Stats'[Target Key], 'RCA Query Stats'[Interval Start UTC], 'RCA Query Stats'[Login], 'RCA Query Stats'[Query ID], 'RCA Query Stats'[Plan ID] ), VAR latest = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Executions] ), 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] = latest ) )

measures.name: Query Wait (ms)
measures.description: Query Store's wait time in context, every category, in milliseconds (PostgreSQL's an estimate from its samples): the latest read of each target, interval, login, query, and plan, summed.
measures.definition: SUMX ( SUMMARIZE ( 'RCA Query Stats', 'RCA Query Stats'[Target Key], 'RCA Query Stats'[Interval Start UTC], 'RCA Query Stats'[Login], 'RCA Query Stats'[Query ID], 'RCA Query Stats'[Plan ID] ), VAR latest = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'RCA Query Stats'[Wait (ms)] ), 'RCA Query Stats'[Captured At UTC] = latest ) )

measures.name: Forced Plans (captured)
measures.description: Plans forced in context as their latest read saw them, by sys.sp_query_store_force_plan or automatic plan correction.
measures.definition: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( SUMMARIZE ( 'RCA Query Plans', 'RCA Query Plans'[Target Key], 'RCA Query Plans'[Plan ID] ), VAR latest = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'RCA Query Plans'[Captured At UTC] ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'RCA Query Plans' ), 'RCA Query Plans'[Captured At UTC] = latest, 'RCA Query Plans'[Is Forced Plan] = TRUE () ) > 0 ) )

measures.name: Plan Forcings (captured)
measures.description: Plans the capture saw forced in context, manually or by automatic plan correction.
measures.definition: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'RCA Query Events' ), 'RCA Query Events'[Kind] = "forced" )

measures.name: Connections Held (captured)
measures.description: The most client connections one sample of a connection episode found on T4 in context, every program and state together.
measures.definition: MAXX ( VALUES ( 'RCA Connections'[Captured At UTC] ), CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'RCA Connections'[Connections] ) ) )

measures.name: Injected Faults
measures.description: Faults the workload injected (the scoreboard and the tests only).
measures.definition: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'RCA Answer Key' ), 'RCA Answer Key'[Kind] = "run" )
